description: This file defines a QuestionGeneratorAgent class that uses a state machine workflow to generate questions, including methods for single and batch question generation, with validation and conditional regeneration logic. It leverages external modules for graph management, logging, and configuration.

classes.name: QuestionState
classes.description: TypedDict schema representing the state of the question generation workflow

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorAgent
classes.description: Agent class that manages question generation workflow using a state graph, including methods for generating single and multiple questions with validation and conditional logic

methods.name: _build_graph
methods.description: Constructs the state graph workflow for question generation

methods.name: _should_regenerate
methods.description: Determines whether to regenerate a question based on validation results and attempt count

methods.name: generate_single_question
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a single validated question for a given chapter and difficulty

methods.name: generate_batch_questions
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a batch of questions concurrently, with a specified maximum number of simultaneous tasks
